summary: Schema 018 is current. RC234 keeps email-only login/display-name presentation, purges accepted invitation tokens from the UI, and uses shadcn/Base UI dialogs, bounded operation/release caches with PostgreSQL or ordered GitHub stable fallback, endpoint-aware registry TLS rollouts, stable-feed diagnosis, and ResourceQuota-safe qualification Jobs. It includes RC219 theme, registry descriptor, Helm capability, Git CAS, builder policy, registry pulls, and Argo recovery.
